definition: I. חֲמוֺר noun [masculine] heap , absolute ׳ ח with dual חֲמֹרָתָ֑יִם ( Baer ׳ חְִמֹרֹת ), as if from חֲמֹרָה ; — בִּלְחִי הַחֲמוֺר חֲמוֺר חֲמֹרָתָ֑יִם Judg 15:16 with the ass's jawbone, a heap, two heaps , i.e. so many slain. חֲמֹרֹתָ֑יִם see I. חֲמוֺר . above

BDB2893 [H2543 H2565]

BDB2892 | BIBLICAL HEBREW | BDB2894

I. חֲמוֺר noun [masculine] heap, absolute ׳ח with dual חֲמֹרָתָ֑יִם (Baer ׳חְִמֹרֹת), as if from חֲמֹרָה; — בִּלְחִי הַחֲמוֺר חֲמוֺר חֲמֹרָתָ֑יִם Judg 15:16 with the ass's jawbone, a heap, two heaps, i.e. so many slain.

חֲמֹרֹתָ֑יִם see I. חֲמוֺר. above
